services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: New for 2024 , 1972 23′ Mako Classic with brand new 150 hp Mercury ProXS. This stable fishing vessel will be equipped with updated electronics and outfitted to get your group out on the water safe and comfortably. I am now setup to run trips inshore and nearshore trips in Florida. I will mainly target tarpon, but we plan on being versatile. Most of the fishing that I do in Florida is similar to striper fishing in Tennessee. The biggest difference is of course the size of the fish and how they pull, but also the variety of fish we will catch on these trips. blurb: Captain Billy Davis is a USCG Licensed guide specializing in unique striper fishing adventures in east Tennessee. He uses large live baits to target large stripers, focusing on surface action rather than deep fishing. Trips may cover several reservoirs or rivers to find quality fish, with an emphasis on education and enjoyment.
